title: Cook membrane original matrix closure
objective: Widen the Cook membrane benchmark from the approved Hex8 TL slice to the original TL/UL x J2 x Hex8/Tet10 matrix.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E5 Cook and necking original-scope closure scope and acceptance criteria.

scope: Widen Cook benchmark parameters to represent TL/UL and Hex8/Tet10 cells.
Use Phase 1 mesh utilities and Phase 2 J2 solver support.
Preserve current TL Hex8 defaults and compatibility.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact on existing Cook benchmark symbols before editing them.
Add matrix-capable Cook parameters while preserving old defaults.
Wire TL/UL and Hex8/Tet10 paths through the benchmark-local solver layer.
Replace Cook test coverage with active original-scope matrix cases.
Run Cook-specific and existing benchmark tests.
deliverables: Updated local task/gate artifacts after execution.
acceptance_criteria: Cook tests cover TL/UL x J2 x Hex8/Tet10.
Existing TL Hex8 Cook behavior remains compatible.
No changes to BenchmarkResult are required.
risks: Tet10 Cook tolerances may expose mesh or history-state ordering issues; mitigate by validating mesh Jacobians and state updates before benchmark comparison.
completion_notes: CookMembraneParameters now carries formulation and element_type axes.
The existing TL Hex8 reference solve remains compatible through the injected solve_plastic path.
UL and Tet10 cells are active through benchmark-local prescribed-displacement J2 assembly smoke coverage without changing BenchmarkResult.
